aboutGame.title: What is Sandustry?
paragraphs: Sandustry is a pixel-physics sandbox factory game from Lantto Games, published by Hooded Horse. You dig into a destructible sand world, refine materials, and automate production with conveyors, filters, fluids, and deeper tech.

Steam Early Access launched August 13, 2026. The store page and EA notes point to roughly a year of updates with more buildings, resources, chains, quests, and technologies. This site is a fan companion—not the official Hooded Horse wiki.
